items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Mysterious death of Albert Ayler, found floating in the East River

ctx.x: Jimi Hendrix is still around, isn’t he?

Oh no. He – Jimi Hendrix died in 1970. Mysterious death of Albert Ayler, found floating in the East River, Louis Armstrong passed a year later. Duke Ellington was dead within a few years. But at the same time, as you just mentioned, Marvin Gaye, Stevie Wonder . . .
